svg.title: DNA-programmed nanoparticle organization
svg.desc: A looping 28-second vector animation. Peach nanoparticles drift freely. The view magnifies one particle to reveal a radially oriented shell of single-stranded DNA. The view returns to an unbound gas-like dispersion, and then the same 24 particles organize into a schematic crystal connected by hybridized DNA. A two-dimensional lattice is used for illustration and does not specify a particular three-dimensional crystal structure. Particle sizes, DNA density, trajectories, and kinetics are schematic and not to scale.
svg.metadata: Original editable vector artwork. No embedded raster images, external fonts, JavaScript, or dependencies. Conceptual reference: https://mirkin-group.northwestern.edu/discoveries-archive/spherical-nucleic-acids/ . Palette adapted from the user's supplied reference. Animation: 0–4 s dispersion, 4–6 s zoom, 6–10 s DNA close-up, 10–12 s zoom-out, 12–16 s gas-like phase, 16–20 s assembly, 20–26 s crystal, 26–28 s return.
